text:
Sam_PartnerOps: FYI CloudHarbor wants a joint co-sell POC with ZenithCorp. They want a hybrid setup: Dedicated for peak traffic + Hosted fallback. Need pricing, OIDC support, HSM/KMS details, and data residency notes. Can SEs take this?
Leah_SE: Happy to lead the SE side. Quick Qs: expected peak qps? seq length? and do they need guaranteed latency SLAs?
CloudHarbor_Paul: Hi all, Paul from CloudHarbor. Target peak ~200 qps, avg prompt 256 tokens in/out, latency target <300ms p95. They require OIDC (Okta) and prefer HSM-backed keys. Data must remain in EU region for logs and telemetry.
Ravi_SolEng: Hybrid is doable. Dedicated pool for steady state + hosted autoscale as overflow. Network notes: outbound to model bucket endpoints + KMS over 443. If HSM required, we can integrate customer HSM via our Private offering or use cloud KMS with BYOK. Example allowlist CIDRs we share for Private: 
```
- 10.50.0.0/16
- 18.197.33.0/24
```
Maya_Security: Security checklist: need Zenith's okta metadata, proof of SOC2 or equivalent, and confirmation on log retention window (default 90 days, can be adjusted). For EU data residency, we need contract clause and a data flow diagram. Also: if HSM is customer-managed, confirm access controls and key rotation policies.
Noah_Sales: Pricing ask: partner expects a POC discount and short reserved commit for Dedicated equivalent to 4x A100 for 3 weeks. What should we ballpark?
Ravi_SolEng: Ballpark reserved pricing: $6k-$9k per A100-equivalent per week depending on quantization and batching. For overflow hosted egress cost add-on ~$0.XX per 1k tokens. Will refine after we get actual token distribution.
Leah_SE: I'll set a kickoff for Thurs 11am PT (90min) if that works. Agenda: architecture diagram, OIDC test flow, HSM approach, perf tests (200 qps), success criteria. I'll pull a runbook and post link.
CloudHarbor_Paul: Ok sounds good. I'll upload Okta metadata and the Zenith security contacts before the meeting. Also: any blockers re. cross-border logs?
Maya_Security: Cross-border is fine if contract and EU residency enforced. We'll need a Data Processing Addendum signed. Flagging legal for contract clause.
Sam_PartnerOps: Action items recap: Leah host kickoff + runbook, Ravi to draft pricing slide + capacity ops, Maya to send EU residency + DPA requirements to legal, Paul to provide Okta metadata and SOC docs. Please flag any infra/legal blockers ASAP.
deploy-bot: Please add calendar event once Leah confirms time. Reminder: attach runbook to event.
